# Web server and live graph page (`startWebUi`)

## What to build

A local HTTP server and a single static page that show a run live, the same graph as the Ink TUI. `src/web/server.ts` serves `GET /` (the page), `GET /state` (the full snapshot as JSON) and `GET /events` (Server-Sent Events: the full snapshot on connect, then one on every change, throttled to 10 per second, with a `: ping` every 15 s), bound to `127.0.0.1` on a random port, with Host and Origin checks on every request. `src/web/page.html` is vanilla JS with an inline SVG that draws the graph (tasks, then validate → code reviewer and live tester → fixer → apply), the phase bar and the latest events, and re-renders from the latest snapshot. `src/web/start.ts` exports `startWebUi(opts: UiOptions)`, an implementation of the same interface as `startUi`, backed by a `RunStore`. Nothing is wired into the CLI in this slice, and the page has no buttons yet.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/ui/start.tsx` (lines 8–62, 63–107) — `UiOptions`, `UiHandle`, `isAgentOutputLine`; `startInk` shows how a `RunStore` is built from `UiOptions` and how `log`/`stop` behave. `startWebUi` must accept the same `UiOptions` and return a `UiHandle` (plus a `url` and a `close()`).
- `src/ui/store.ts` (lines 1–180) — `RunStore`, `ViewState`, `NodeView`, `EVENTS_KEPT`; `getState()` returns an immutable snapshot, `subscribe(listener)` fires on every change. `ViewState` is JSON-safe.
- `src/ui/Graph.tsx` (lines 20–127, 129–131) — `AGENT_TITLE`, the pipeline node ids `@gate`, `@merge`, `@reviewer`…, and `graphRows()`'s lines 80–111 which build the node list, the layers (tasks, gate, optional gate fixer, reviewer+tester, fixer, merge) and the parent map. Extract that part into a pure `graphModel()` so the page and the TUI share it.
- `src/ui/theme.ts` (lines 4–25) — `THEME` and `STATUS_COLOR` hex values the page must reuse.
- `src/ui/Graph.tsx` `statusText` (lines 13–18) and `src/runner/events.ts` `phaseLabel` (lines 15–20) — texts the page must reproduce (`retry N/M`, `fixing N/M`, `revalidate N/M`, `review round N`).
- `src/ui/App.tsx` (lines 177–195, 240–262) — header (title, run id, provider, elapsed), phase bar, progress `n/m tasks merged`, events panel (last 3 lines).
- `src/readme/readme.ts` (line 7–9) — how a packaged static file is located with `new URL("../../README.md", import.meta.url)`.
- `package.json` (scripts `postbuild`, `files`) and `tsconfig.build.json` — `tsc` does not copy `.html`, so the build must.
- `src/ui/start.test.ts`, `src/ui/store.test.ts` — test style for UI pieces.

## Patterns to follow

**Shared node ids.** Create `src/runner/nodes.ts` (another task may create the identical file; keep exactly this content):
```typescript
import type { ReviewAgent } from "./events.js";

/** Ids of the pipeline nodes after the task graph; `@` cannot start a task id that reads well, and never collides. */
export const GATE_NODE = "@gate";
export const MERGE_NODE = "@merge";
export const AGENT_NODE: Record<ReviewAgent, string> = {
  reviewer: "@reviewer",
  tester: "@tester",
  fixer: "@fixer",
  gateFixer: "@gate-fixer",
};
export const isPipelineNode = (id: string): boolean => id.startsWith("@");
```
`Graph.tsx` imports these instead of its private `GATE`, `MERGE`, `AGENT_ID` constants.

**Node-http, no framework.** The repo's only runtime deps are commander, execa, ink, ink-spinner, react, zod: use `node:http` and zod only. Persisted/transport JSON is validated with zod where it is read back.

**Test pattern:** real server on port 0 in the test, `afterEach` closes it; plain-mode UI tests in `src/ui/start.test.ts:8–60`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### EDIT `src/ui/Graph.tsx` and CREATE `src/ui/model.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: move the construction of `nodes`, `allLayers`, `allParents` (Graph.tsx lines 80–111) into `graphModel({ layers, parents, state, mergeTarget }): { nodes: Map<string, { title; view }>; layers: string[][]; parents: Record<string, readonly string[]> }` in `src/ui/model.ts`; `graphRows` calls it. Export `AGENT_TITLE` from there too (re-export from `Graph.tsx` so existing imports keep working).
- **GOTCHA**: no behavior change in the TUI; `src/ui/App.test.tsx` and `layout.test.ts` must pass untouched.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -- ui`

### CREATE `src/web/server.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `createWebServer({ store: RunStore, meta: { layers, parents, mergeTarget?, runId, provider, startedAt }, pageFile? }): Promise<{ url: string; port: number; close(): Promise<void>; server: http.Server }>`, listening on `127.0.0.1` with port `0`.
  - `snapshot()` = `{ ...store.getState(), graph: { nodes: [{ id, title, view }], layers, parents }, runId, provider, mergeTarget, startedAt }`, where `graph` comes from `graphModel()` (turn the Map into an array). `GET /state` returns it as JSON (`cache-control: no-store`).
  - `GET /events`: `content-type: text/event-stream`; on connect write `event: state\ndata: <json>\n\n`; subscribe to the store and send the newest snapshot at most every 100 ms (coalesce); write `: ping\n\n` every 15 s; clean up listeners and timers on `close`.
  - `GET /` serves `page.html` (`text/html; charset=utf-8`). Every other path → 404; non-GET methods → 405 for now.
  - **Host check on every request:** the `Host` header must be exactly `127.0.0.1:<port>` or `localhost:<port>`, else **421**. **Origin check:** if an `Origin` header is present on a `POST`, it must be `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` or `http://localhost:<port>`, else **403** (POSTs arrive in a later task; implement the check in the shared request entry now). There is no token.
  - Structure routing as a table keyed by `"METHOD /path"` so later tasks add POST routes without touching the checks.
- **GOTCHA**: `close()` must end open SSE responses (`res.end()`) and call `server.closeAllConnections()` so it resolves quickly.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -- web`

### CREATE `src/web/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: one file with inline CSS and JS, no build step, no framework, no external requests. On load fetch `/state` once, then open `new EventSource("/events")` and re-render from each `state` event. Render: header (title, run id, provider, elapsed), phase bar (`tasks → validate → review → fix → done`, current highlighted, label from `phase`), progress (`n/m tasks merged`), an inline SVG graph laid out top-down with one row per entry of `graph.layers` and edges from each parent to its children (cubic or elbow paths), node boxes with title and status text (reproduce `statusText`: `retry N/M` when `running` and `attempt > 1`; `fixing r/R`; `revalidate r/R`), spinner (CSS animation) on `running|validating|fixing|merging`, and an events panel with the last lines. Colors: the `THEME`/`STATUS_COLOR` hexes from `src/ui/theme.ts` for dark, with a light variant; follow `prefers-color-scheme` via CSS custom properties. A `data-node-id` attribute on each node element (later tasks attach click handlers).
- When the SSE connection drops, show "Disconnected" and stop retrying after 1 minute (close the `EventSource` yourself once 60 s have passed since the first error).
- **GOTCHA**: render node text with `textContent`/`createElementNS`, never `innerHTML` with run data (events and task ids come from the repo).
- **VALIDATE**: manual: `node -e` a script that starts `createWebServer` over a `RunStore` fed with fake events and open the page; the unit tests below cover the data path.

### CREATE `src/web/start.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `startWebUi(opts: UiOptions): WebUiHandle` where `WebUiHandle = UiHandle & { url: string; close(): Promise<void> }`. Builds the `RunStore` from `opts` (use `opts.store` when `UiOptions` has an optional `store?: RunStore` — add that optional field to `UiOptions` in `src/ui/start.tsx` if it is not there yet, keeping a single declaration) and calls `createWebServer`. `log(line)`: same rule as `startInk` (`isAgentOutputLine` lines are dropped, others go to `store.addEvent`). `stop()` does NOT close the server (the page keeps serving the final state; a later task closes it) but detaches nothing else. Because `createWebServer` is async and `startUi` is sync, make `startWebUi` async (`Promise<WebUiHandle>`), the caller awaits it; keep `log` safe to call before the server is ready.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run typecheck`

### EDIT `package.json`

- **IMPLEMENT**: extend `postbuild` so `src/web/page.html` is copied to `dist/web/page.html` (use the existing `node -e` style with `require('node:fs')`, create the directory). `files` already ships `dist`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').accessSync('dist/web/page.html')"`

### CREATE tests `src/web/server.test.ts`, `src/web/start.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `/state` returns the store's snapshot including `graph.layers` with the pipeline layers; a late SSE subscriber gets the full current state first (use `fetch` and read the stream, or `http.get`); a store change produces a new `state` event, and 20 rapid changes produce far fewer than 20 events within 100 ms; `Host: evil.example` → 421 (use `node:http` `request` with a custom `headers.host`, `fetch` cannot set it); `POST /anything` with `Origin: https://evil.example` → 403; `GET /` returns HTML containing `<svg` or `EventSource`; `close()` ends an open SSE stream. `startWebUi`: `log` keeps non-agent lines in the snapshot's `events` and drops `[label] …` lines.
- **VALIDATE**: `npm test -- web`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /`, `/state`, `/events` work as described on `127.0.0.1:<random port>`; a bad `Host` gets 421, a foreign `Origin` on POST gets 403.
- [ ] A reload or late open shows the full current state (SSE sends the snapshot first).
- [ ] The page draws the same node set as the TUI (tasks, validate, [validation fixer], code reviewer, live tester, fixer, apply) with arrows from each task to its dependents.
- [ ] `npm run build` puts `page.html` in `dist/web/`.
- [ ] The TUI is unchanged (`npm test -- ui` passes untouched).
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -- web ui`

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -- web ui
```
